---
# ocp4_workload_remittance_hub: message journal and settlement API for the remittance lab
- name: Create the remittance hub namespace
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    api_version: v1
    kind: Namespace
    name: "{{ remittance_hub_namespace }}"
    state: present

- name: Create the message journal claim
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    definition:
      apiVersion: v1
      kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
      metadata:
        name: remittance-journal
        namespace: "{{ remittance_hub_namespace }}"
      spec:
        accessModes:
          - ReadWriteOnce
        storageClassName: "{{ remittance_hub_storage_class | default('gp3-csi') }}"
        resources:
          requests:
            storage: "{{ remittance_hub_journal_size | default('20Gi') }}"

- name: Bind the journal claim, or report why it did not bind
  block:
    - name: Wait for the journal claim to bind
      kubernetes.core.k8s_info:
        api_version: v1
        kind: PersistentVolumeClaim
        name: remittance-journal
        namespace: "{{ remittance_hub_namespace }}"
      register: r_journal_pvc
      until: (r_journal_pvc.resources | first).status.phase | default('') == 'Bound'
      retries: 30
      delay: 10
  rescue:
    - name: Read the journal claim events
      kubernetes.core.k8s_info:
        api_version: v1
        kind: Event
        namespace: "{{ remittance_hub_namespace }}"
        field_selectors:
          - involvedObject.name=remittance-journal
      register: r_journal_events

    - name: Show the journal claim events
      ansible.builtin.debug:
        msg: "{{ r_journal_events.resources | map(attribute='message') | list }}"

    - name: Stop the workload
      ansible.builtin.fail:
        msg: "journal claim remittance-journal did not bind"

- name: Deploy the settlement API
  kubernetes.core.k8s:
    state: present
    template: settlement-api.yaml.j2

# remittance-hub-lab: cross-border payments messaging lab on OpenShift
cloud_provider: ec2
env_type: ocp4-cluster

__meta__:
  catalog:
    display_name: Remittance Hub Lab
    category: Labs
  deployer:
    scm_url: https://github.com/agnosticd/agnosticd-v2.git
    scm_ref: main

workloads:
  - ocp4_workload_remittance_hub

# Leave empty so the cluster's default storage class is used
remittance_hub_storage_class: ""
remittance_hub_journal_size: 20Gi
